{{Quote|I'm to escort Master Axlon the rest of the way to Governor Ferrouz. Major Pakrie's orders. ''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''We'll need to see your authorization.|Emperor's Hand Mara Jade and the lieutenant|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''lieutenant''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[palace guard corps]] that protected Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]]'s [[Whitestone City palace|residence]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] escorted Ferrouz's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ally, [[Vestin Axlon]], to the governor's office. On his way to the office, the lieutenant encountered [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who claimed that Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pakrie]] had given her permission to escort Axlon to Ferrouz's office. The palace guard asked for authorization, which Jade was unable to provide. The Emperor's Hand attempted to contact Pakrie, but the major did not respond, prompting her to shout in fury. The lieutenant, who did not wish to anger Jade, allowed the other to join Axlon's escort. Shortly after, Jade and the Rebel entered Ferrouz's office.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The lieutenant appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
